headline: Requests to pay $292,223.95 in Republic Services invoices and accept several grants and donations.
summary: Requests include paying $292,223.95 in Republic Services invoices with FY2027 funds and accepting $4,545 in donations. Other items cover election costs, police details, and a City Auditor memo on accounts that exceed their authorization.
items: Accept $4,545 in donations for Cape Ann Veterans Services District
Pay FY2026 Republic Services invoices, $292,223.95, with FY2027 funds
Accept a 2010 surplus Lark utility trailer
Accept FY2027 SAFE grant, $5,657.12, and Senior SAFE grant, $2,387.18
Accept $40,000 Earmark Grant from Department of Fire Services
Accept $10,000 FY2027 Federal Title III-B Older Americans Provider Services Grant
Pay $1,925 for 2026 custodial coverage for elections, #2027-SBT-4
Pay police details for November 3, 2026 State Election, $536.60 and $9,676.43, #2027-SBT-5 and #2027-SBT-6
Pay $1,015 for early voting staff for September 1 and November 3, 2026 elections, #2027-SA-4
City Auditor memo on accounts exceeding their authorization, and Auditor's Report
location: City Hall, 1st Floor Council Conference Room, 9 Dale Avenue, Gloucester, MA 01930

CITY CLERK GLOUCESTER, MA 2026 NOV 25 AM 8:37

## AGENDA

**Individual items from committee reports may be consolidated into a consent agenda**

1. Memorandum from the Cape Ann Veterans Services District Director requesting acceptance of donations in the amount of $4,545.
2. Memorandum from the DPW Financial Manager requesting approval to pay FY2026 invoices with FY2027 funds for Republic Services in the amount of $292,223.95.
3. Memorandum from the Assistant Fire Chief requesting acceptance of a 2010 surplus Lark utility trailer.
4. Memorandum from the Fire Chief requesting acceptance of the FY2027 Student Awareness of Fire Education (SAFE) grant in the amount of $5,657.12 & the Senior SAFE grant in the amount of $2,387.18.
5. Memorandum from the Fire Chief requesting acceptance of the Earmark Grant from the Department of Fire Services (DFS) in the amount of $40,000.
6. Memorandum from the Director of Public Works requesting acceptance of the 2026 Recycling Dividends Grant in the amount of $14,700.
7. Memorandum from the Director of Elder Services requesting acceptance of the FY2027 Federal Title III-B Older Americans Provider Services Grant in the amount of $10,000.
8. Memorandum from the City Clerk & #2027-SBT-4 in the amount of $1,925 for 2026 custodial coverage for elections.
9. Memorandum from the City Clerk & #2027-SBT-5 in the amount of $536.60 & #2027-SBT-6 in the amount of $9,676.43 for Police Details for the November 3, 2026 State Election.
10. Memorandum from the City Clerk & #2027-SA-4 in the amount of $1,015 for early voting staff for the September 1, 2026 & November 3, 2026 elections.
11. Memorandum from the City Auditor regarding accounts having expenditures which exceed their authorization & Auditor's Report and other related business
